blocks.text: Kris Aquino revealed that she and her son Bimby had a chance encounter with his dad, James Yap, at a hospital, with the celebrity mom saying she was the first to greet her former husband. Kris and Bimby shared this during their livestream for an e-commerce platform on Wednesday, Nov. 11. While they did not expound when the unexpected meeting happened, Bimby said Yap was at the hospital at the time for his daughter Francesca. “We ran into [James] in the hospital.
